answers.core: I don't believe add-ons can modify the GDScript analyzer or provide custom error messages like this.
answers.workaround: Once newcomers learn about this difference and/or stop using Godot 3 materials, it won't be necessary for them anymore. But we should want to make it as easy as possible for people to get started with modern Godot, and a strange error like "Unexpected 'Identifier'" doesn't help in that regard.

title: Add custom error message for Godot 3 `export` syntax
